posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
the "package.json" should look like this (for windows at least)
Code:
{
    "name": "",
    "main": "index.html",
    "js-flags": "--expose-gc",
    "window": {
        "title": "",
        "toolbar": false,
        "position": "center",
        "width": 816,
        "height": 624,
        "icon": "icon/icon.png"
    }
}
nothing more, nothing less  (position is optional to start in center of the screen,
rather than top left (which does for me).
make sure the icon folder exist, as it does work.

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
Jasanimation said:
So i found out that the game icon WORKS on deployment thank goodness, but it didnt work while developing
Click to expand...
did you deploy your game into your project or copy a package file over at some point? in a deployment, theres 2 package files.
theres one in the main folder that'd have "icon": "www/icon/icon.png". The second one is inside the www folder and is a copy of the one you'd see inside your project's main folder.
that one would have "icon": "icon/icon.png". the one you shared looks like one from a deployment, but if its your project's package file then try changing the icon path property
